concept.title: Volunteering and giving time
concept.shortdesc: Becoming a volunteer, member or fundraiser and contributing time and effort to a charity, club, event or local community.

keywords.keyword: help out at a local charity

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: joining a charity as a member
taking part in community activities: see (attending as a participant rather than giving time)
getting support to access the community: see (receiving support rather than contributing)
finding information about volunteering opportunities: see (information-seeking, not doing the volunteering)
